params.body:
The "How we read" scene told our own story: a marketer asks ChatGPT about Gen Z, a deck quotes an old survey, and those patterns lead to "Teams want culture already read". It read as an abstract pitch rather than as the work itself.

It now shows a real reading, a trend that is on gentells.com ("Young People Pay for Offline Time but Keep Their Group Chats"):

- **Signals:**
  - A club seals phones at the door
  - Students buy a dumbphone for exams
  - Friends keep the group chat on a detox
- **Patterns:**
  - Offline is a ticket
  - Dumb on purpose
  - The chat stays on
- **Direction:** Young people pay for offline time

As before, there are no brand names or figures, because the scene is an illustration and not a measurement.

This replaces #186: its "2023 survey" signal is gone.

Tests: 367 passing. Checked locally at three points of the scroll; the pattern labels fit side by side.
params.title: How we read: a real example, the trend Young people pay for offline time
